notes.v110.session.title: Session Recap
notes.v110.session.text: A new box shows your rating when the session started and now, and your latest matches with the hero, the place and the rating change. It shows in a match and on the Battlegrounds menu. Right-click it to start a new session.
notes.v110.layout.title: One column by the leaderboard
notes.v110.layout.text: The lobby minion types, the sidebar and the Session Recap can now be merged together with Assemble Panels setting on for your unique layout, or positioned separately on the screen. Right clicking gives you the options on some panels for interaction, and to disassemble. If the rows are too wide, you can activate two-lines mode to make them taller instead(might look funky in some places).
notes.v110.ready.title: Ready-made configs
notes.v110.ready.text: The Config page has ready-made setups: the toolkit's own default(recommended), and versions for players who run Firestone or Hearthstone Deck Tracker(measured at release, other trackers might create features that'd need those configs changed) beside it, which turn off what that app already shows.
notes.v110.lobbytypes.title: Lobby minion types, your way
notes.v110.lobbytypes.text: Have the lobby types box out as 1x5, 5x1, 2x3 or 3x2, whatever suits your vision. Show icons, names or both, and turn on or off the banned types to show crossed out underneath.
notes.v110.sizes.title: Size what's by the portraits
notes.v110.sizes.text: Two sliders set the size of the name and MMR plate and of the tier and minion type icons by the leaderboard portraits, with a picture that follows as you drag to help visualize.
notes.v110.bell.title: The bell
notes.v110.bell.text: A bell next to the in-game search button turns green when a new version is out and yellow for new patch notes. The bell and the search button can be moved and resized like the other boxes now(was highly requested).
notes.v110.mods.title: BepInEx mods
notes.v110.mods.text: See the mods from hsbg.cards, which of them you have and at which version, and open their Setup in one click. New in the list: Tantrum's Board Fix, which keeps your board from jumping around, which many players could be familiar with, now integrated to be installed and uninstalled quickly from the Toolkit.
notes.v110.ukrainian.title: Ukrainian
notes.v110.ukrainian.text: The toolkit's menus, panels and Setup are now also in Ukrainian. Cards and the card search stay in English for the language.
notes.v110.matchdata.title: Community stats
notes.v110.matchdata.text: After each Solos match the toolkit sends a short report to hsbg.cards, with no names attached. Everyone's matches add up to community statistics of heroes, minion types and places, with data shown completely free of charge. You can turn it off here.
